Definition: from G1793; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:--intercession, prayer.
BiblicalUsage: Intercession — prayer made on behalf of another. Paul urges supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings for all men in 1 Timothy 2:1, and says food is sanctified by the word of God and prayer in 1 Timothy 4:5.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, intercession is the widest kind of prayer — it reaches people I will never meet, and God counts it.
